The '''Masgen system''' was located in the [[Churnis sector/Legends|Churnis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated between the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion]] and [[Kalaan system/Legends|Kalaan systems]] on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="EGTW" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Tarro]] [[operative]] [[Qatak Qantaras]], who was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], worked in the Masgen [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="GG12" /> The system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Masgen system was created by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square I-7.<ref name="TEA" />
